about.title: About Our Company
about.heading: Building Trusted International Employment Opportunities
about.p1: AL SEGER TRADING PLC is a professional Ethiopian employment agency dedicated to training and connecting skilled workers with reliable opportunities in Middle Eastern countries.
about.p2: We focus on professionalism, safety, legal recruitment, and preparing workers with the skills and confidence needed for international employment success.

vision.title: Vision, Mission & Integrity
vision.visionText: To become one of Ethiopia's most trusted and respected international recruitment agencies by empowering workers with global employment opportunities.
vision.missionText: To provide professional recruitment, training, and legal overseas employment services while ensuring worker safety, preparation, and success.
vision.integrityText: We believe in honesty, transparency, professionalism, and ethical recruitment practices in every stage of our service.

services.title: What We Provide
services.overseasText: Connecting Ethiopian workers with trusted employers abroad.
services.visaText: Complete support for travel and visa processing procedures.
services.trainingText: Preparing workers with practical and professional skills.
services.docsText: Assistance with all legal and recruitment documentation.

trust.title: Professional & Reliable
trust.legalText: We follow official and legal international recruitment procedures.
trust.globalText: Strong partnerships with employers across Middle Eastern countries.
trust.teamText: Dedicated professionals helping workers throughout the process.
